Max: heads-up I'm seeing p99 jump from ~210ms -> 1.3s on canary when QPS > 1200. correlates with a kernel-selection change landed in last deploy.
Anya: logs? link? :eyes:
Max: pasted sample:
```
[perf] req=0x7f2... latency=1320ms kernel=fallback-matmul microbatch=32 kv_miss=0.45 evicted=1200/sec
[cache] shard=3 size=64MB evictions=1187/10s
```
Kevin: that's classic cache saturation + larger microbatching. microbatch=32 increases KV live set causing churn. Did you see KV hit rate by shard?
Max: yes, hit rate dropped from 0.83 -> 0.56 under sustained load. tail latency correlates with eviction bursts.
Priya: is the new kernel selecting slower kernels when KV misses increase? might be compounding.
Max: profiler shows kernel selection switching to fallback slower kernels at runtime: 60% fallback when miss rate > 0.4
Kevin: quick repro: run `perf/trace` with `--kv-stats --per-shard` and look for `eviction_burst` counter.
Anya: tried reducing microbatch to 12 in canary (manual override) — p99 back down to 260ms within 2 mins :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy bot: rollback requested for deploy 2026-03-26T10:12Z by Max. status=queued
SRE-Oncall: will monitor and patch autoscaler, but we should add adaptive microbatching and softer eviction policy. avoid hard LRU resets.
Priya: action items: (1) run per-shard stress with varying microbatch sizes and measure p95/p99 (2) add eviction_burst alarm at 50/s (3) prototype adaptive microbatcher that lowers batch size on high kv_miss
Max: I'll add repro scripts and a short perf-run doc. assigning Kevin + Priya to experiments. 
Kevin: I'll also capture kernel-selection trace from the runtime (we saw fallback rule: if seq_len>512 & kv_miss>0.3 use fallback-matmul)
Anya: FYI might need to increase cache bytes per shard short-term for big customers.
Max: thanks. keeping this thread for timeline. cc @all
